title: How Does a Toaster Know When to Pop? #Shorts
description:
Plot twist: your toaster isn't watching your bread. It's counting. Push the lever and an electromagnet holds the rack down against a spring while a timer chip counts. Time's up, the magnet lets go and the spring launches your toast. Plus why the lever won't stay down when it's unplugged.

Explained in 60 #6
